Weighted Manhattan cost difference D1=Σw(2x_i−1/2) and weighted squared Euclidean difference D2=Σw(x_i−1/4) satisfy exact D1=2D2, so have identical sign and ties; reflecting chambers gives the stated weighted origin cell. For infinity explicit (0.3,0.3,0.151) has Manhattan choose half and max choose integer; exact rational p=3 likewise.
